_comment: Checked-in viz defaults. `colors` maps a MODEL NAME (experiment leaf with the agent prefix and the -<quant>-<extra> suffix stripped, e.g. alan-MiniMax-M2.7-Q8-fo -> MiniMax-M2.7) to its default bar colour. `order_by: model_name` sorts experiments by model name (grouping families) when the interface has no saved order. Per-interface user overrides (colours, order, toggles) live in ~/.regact/viz_settings/ and take precedence over these.
